Advertisement Notice
Applications along with resume are invited for three (03) posts of Trainee Operator in Dr. A.P.J. Abdul
Kalam Computer Centre. Please do provide your e-mail address and mobile number. Applications should
be submitted using Google form at https://forms.gle/D9aeAeTq3uzPvqeh8
Last date of Application
 Applications should be submitted on or before 03.10.2023, 12:00 Noon.
Qualification
 Candidates who have done Diploma in Computer/IT/Electronics/
Electrical and other equivalent discipline.
Or
 Bachelor in Computer Application (BCA)
Or
 Master of Computer Application (MCA)
Or
 B.E./B. Tech (CS & E/ECE/IT)
Tenure
 The tenure of the training will be one year only.
Stipend
 Fixed stipend of Rs. 8000/- pm will be paid to each trainee operator.
Interview
 Interview will be held on 5th October 2023 at 02:30 p.m. in the office of Director,
Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Computer Centre, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
 Candidates are required to bring one hard copy of the Resume and photocopies of
all the required documents along with original certificates at the time of interview.
 Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Computer Centre handles network management and
maintenance, software development, IT Facilitation etc. The candidate will be
provided training in these areas.
Sd/
(Prof. Anu Gupta)
Director
